name: mdifferentiableAt_atlas

name: mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm

name: symm_comp_deriv
statement: M} (hx : x ∈ e.source) : (mfderiv% e.symm (e x)).comp (mfderiv% e x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 (TangentSpace I x)

statement: M} {y : E} (hy : y ∈ (extChartAt I x).target) : (mfderiv% (extChartAt I x) ((extChartAt I x).symm y)) ∘L (mfderiv[range I] (extChartAt I x).symm y) = ContinuousLinearMap.id _ _

name: TangentBundle.continuousLinearMapAt_trivializationAt

statement: M} (hx : x ∈ (chartAt H x₀).source) : (trivializationAt E (TangentSpace I) x₀).symmL 𝕜 x = mfderiv[range I] (extChartAt I x₀).symm (extChartAt I x₀ x)
